parameters.query:
-- Customer lookup by code. Zero rows => 404.
SELECT
    c.id,
    c.first_name
FROM customers c
WHERE c.customer_code = $1;

-- Idempotent insert: one ticket per conversation. Duplicate request_id => no row.
INSERT INTO tickets (customer_id, description, priority, request_id)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
ON CONFLICT (request_id) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id, status, created_at;
